findings.finding: The right-hand 30% and 40% labels sit directly against bar endpoints in both themes. Arithmetic and the common bar zero are correct.

findings.finding: The initial whole dark image presentation appeared to omit six inner-box labels. They are present with valid fill values in the SVG and 5513 dark pixels in the tested 420x78 PNG area, equal to light. A fresh magnified crop visually confirmed all labels.
findings.status: Initial omission observation withdrawn as a source/renderer defect. Original image untouched. Does not establish live-site or accessibility acceptance.
